answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can trade: the stake is slashed when peers prove duplicate identities or fabricated transactions, so each fake account adds real cost instead of free influence. New identities begin in a lagoon of low-value, rate-limited tasks, and only sustained verified work can bridge them into high-value markets and earn an ivory audit credential. Revoking stake and credential on proof of fraud makes mass forgery unprofitable, while honest agents keep both.
